mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound (outbound_id, outbound_date, coa_code, outbound_location, remark) VALUES (#{outboundId}, #{outboundDate}, #{coaCode}, #{outboundLocation}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(outbound_id FROM '\d+$') AS INTEGER)), 0) FROM outbound WHERE outbound_id LIKE CONCAT('O-', #{dateStr}, '-%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbound WHERE outbound_date = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM outbound o JOIN outbound_item oi ON o.outbound_id = oi.outbound_id WHERE o.outbound_date = CURRENT_DATE

SELECT TO_CHAR(o.outbound_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0)::INTEGER AS "qty" FROM outbound o JOIN outbound_item oi ON o.outbound_id = oi.outbound_id WHERE o.outbound_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 month') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.outbound_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY "month"
